key_catalyst: WSJ report that Nvidia is in talks to provide a ~$250B backstop to finance an OpenAI data center, reviving AI circular-financing fears
reasoning: The Nvidia $250B OpenAI backstop report is a novel, high-severity escalation of the AI capex/circular-financing theme that drove QQQ down -1.90% (07-23) and -1.12% (07-24) on Alphabet/Tesla capex fears; Nvidia is the single largest QQQ weight and fell 4.5% Monday with weakness persisting. This lands directly ahead of binary MSFT/META (Wed) and AAPL/AMZN (Thu) earnings plus a Fed decision where Polymarket hike odds have jumped above 70%, so the -1.66% pre-market move reflects a still-developing, unresolved catalyst rather than a fully absorbed one.
